defs.def: to achieve sth that you have been trying to do or get; to have the result or effect that was intended 达到目的；实现目标；办到；做成

defs.def: to be successful in your job, earning money, power, respect, etc. 成功；有成就；有作为

ex.s: The spider tried and failed six times before finally succeeding.
ex.t: 蜘蛛试了6次,失败了6次,才终于成功.

ex.s: After months of trial and error he succeeded.
ex.t: 经过几个月的考验和失误,他取得了成功。

ex.s: How did Miss Chevalier succeed in making Addie truly understand the word “impetuous”?
ex.t: 舍瓦利埃小姐如何成功地使艾迪真正理解“软弱”一词?

ex.s: By my fourth year, my desperation to succeed overshadowed my desire for independence.
ex.t: 到了第四年,我对成功的绝望使我独立的愿望蒙上阴影。

ex.s: 9. _________ several adjustments to the design for two months, the engineer eventually succeeded in building a highly efficient system.
ex.t: 9. 工程师对设计进行了两个月的几次调整,最终成功地建立了一个高效的系统。

ex.s: Everyone has a chance to succeed in their pursuit.
ex.t: 每个人都有机会在追求中取得成功。

ex.s: Key Skills for Young Adults to Succeed in Future
ex.t: 年轻人未来成功的关键技能

ex.s: No more feeling like I needed to change who I am in order to succeed.
ex.t: 不再感觉我需要改变自己 才能成功

ex.s: Ehlers eventually succeeded in coaxing the animal to him.
ex.t: 埃勒斯最终成功地将动物归罪于他.

ex.s: 10．（1分）Most colleges now offer first﹣year students a course specially________to help them succeed academically and personally．（  ）
ex.t: 10. (111) 多数学院现在为一年级学生提供专门课程,帮助他们在学术和个人上取得成功。 ()

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上,我们大多数人逐渐缩小了生活的多样性,我们在专业化领域取得了成功,然后陷入其中,没有什么令我们感到惊讶,我们失去了我们的奇妙感,但是,如果我们愿意学习,机会无处不在。

ex.s: C．Miss the opportunity to succeed．
ex.t: C. 错过了成功的机会。

ex.s: Consequently, she succeeded in making a kind of candy only using natural sweeteners, which can reduce oral bacteria.
ex.t: 因此,她成功地只使用天然甜剂制造一种糖果,可以减少口腔细菌.

ex.s: It is still not known if he succeeded in reaching the top of Qomolangma before it took his life.
ex.t: 至今还不知道他是否在夺去生命之前成功到达了科莫朗格玛的顶部.

ex.s: To succeed, people must have the physical as well as 5_______________.
ex.t: 为了取得成功,人们必须拥有身体和5++。

ex.s: Life is queer with its twists and turns, As every one of us sometimes learns, And many a failure turns about, When he might have won had he stuck it out; Don't give up though the pace seems slow - You may succeed with another blow.
ex.t: 生活与它的曲折和转折是奇异的, 正如我们每个人有时所学, 和许多失败的转折, 当他可能已经赢了,如果他坚持了它; 不要放弃,尽管速度看起来很慢—— 你可能会以另一次打击成功。

ex.s: VS If at first you don't succeed, set yourself another goal.
ex.t: VS如果你一开始没有成功,就为自己设定另一个目标.

ex.s: And after some work with a colored pencil I succeeded in making my first drawing.
ex.t: 在用彩色铅笔做一些工作之后, 我成功地完成了我的第一个画。

to gain the right to a title, property, etc. when sb dies 继承
